evidence: Adds consensus parameters in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp defining difficulty adjustment rules and BIP 54 activation.
rationale: Introduces Testnet 5 (BIP 95) consensus parameters to replace problematic previous testnets suffering from severe difficulty manipulation and block storms. As noted in the description, 'Testnet 3 and Testnet 4 frequently suffer from block storms... due to the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule', which Testnet 5 eliminates while raising the minimum difficulty and activating BIP 54 from block 1.
